podcast.title: Internet Radio Host (Stranger Radio)
podcast.body: Steve Fairweather, the current bass player for Gobb, previously hosted an internet radio station named Stranger Radio for a period. "His replacement, Steve Fairweather, is still with the group, and hosted an internet radio station called Stranger Radio for a while."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Published Poet (The Cold Brook Library)
podcast.body: Fairweather is also a published poet, with a book titled "The Cold Brook Library." This work delves into his experiences as a teenager navigating the drug scene in Vancouver. "He's also a published poet, with a book called The Cold Brook Library, which speaks of his life as a teenager caught up in Vancouver's drug scene."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
